data.title: 02 · 温室里偷到的一口甜
data.description: 温室休息时，02 穿白衬衫和橄榄绿背带裤，坐在矮凳上把一小滴蜂蜜抹到面包上。她认真抬高面包看看有没有滴落，确认安全后露出得意笑容，粉发和红色小角被叶影轻轻遮映。
data.action: 抬高抹好蜂蜜的面包检查滴落，得意一笑。
data.promptProse: Zero Two sits on a low greenhouse stool in a white cotton shirt and olive full-length overalls, spreading one small drop of honey onto bread. She lifts the slice to check for drips, then smiles triumphantly. The medium portrait places planting beds and overlapping leaves behind her pink hair and red horns. Leaf-filtered daylight spots the bread and rolled cuffs, with soft green reflections beneath her face and darker gaps among the plants.
